title: Conversion Funnel Bottleneck Diagnostics
description: Multi-stage sequential event analysis to pinpoint drop-off friction points and user flow leakage.
conditions: Multi-step sequential user journeys (e.g. Landing -> Signup -> Onboarding -> Checkout)
Need to prioritize UX engineering interventions based on highest conversion impact
recommended_methods: Stage-by-stage conversion and abandonment rate calculation
Step drop-off impact scoring: Drop_Impact = Users_Entering_Step * Step_Drop_Rate
Time-to-convert latency distribution across funnel stages
selection_rules: Prioritize fixing the funnel step with the highest absolute user loss, not necessarily highest percentage drop
Segment funnel conversion by acquisition channel, device type, and user demographic
Examine whether users dropping out of Step N are abandoning permanently or converting via alternative paths
limitations: Assumes linear progression; real users navigate back-and-forth across non-linear multi-session paths
Funnel analysis does not reveal emotional or qualitative reasons for drop-off (requires user session replays)
